en.title: AI-assisted VMware automation.
en.subtitle: For operations teams · efficient work · traceable actions
en.speech: VMware operations teams handle inventory checks, incident investigations and repeatable changes every day. VMware Skills brings AI assistance and focused automation to that work. It is designed to reduce repetitive information gathering while keeping evidence, existing permissions and auditability in the workflow. Start with the read-only Monitor.

en.title: One family. Focused responsibilities.
en.subtitle: 15 skills · 14 MCP servers · shared Policy library
en.speech: The family covers vSphere, networking, storage, observability and more. Pilot coordinates workflows. Domain servers connect to their management systems. Policy provides shared checks, sanitization and audit logging. Start with the read-only Monitor.

en.title: From a question to real inventory.
en.subtitle: Historical screenshot excerpt · original English output
en.speech: Here is a historical screenshot from an actual session. The inventory view returned one vCenter, two standalone hosts, and thirteen VMs. The notes column containing environment identifiers is omitted. These are recorded results, not a fresh inventory of the environment.

en.title: Health with context, not guesswork.
en.subtitle: Captured observations · verify timing and scope
en.speech: The health screenshot records connected hosts and critical alarms in the same view. That does not establish a current incident. Check when the observation was captured and whether the alarms still apply before deciding what to investigate next.

en.title: Plan changes with explicit boundaries.
en.subtitle: Assess → review → execute → verify
en.speech: When changes are needed, use the relevant domain skill and a reviewed workflow. Existing VMware permissions and local policy still apply. Destructive tools use preview and confirmation gates. A confirmation flag is not independent human approval, and rollback is best effort.

en.title: Also included: task-level model self-tests.
en.subtitle: Optional supporting capability · synthetic tasks, not live execution
en.speech: An optional model self-test helps your team assess which model fits its tasks. Compare the same synthetic scenarios using automatic checks and human review. This supports model choice, without executing VMware changes or guaranteeing production reliability.

en.title: Finish with a traceable audit trail.
en.subtitle: Historical export summary · target identifiers omitted
en.speech: Finally, follow the audit trail. This is an assistant-prepared summary of exported records, showing time, skill, tool, MCP or CLI, status and duration. We omit the target column and show fourteen rows. Names reflect the captured version; use the original records to check completeness.

en.title: Help your VMware team work more efficiently.
en.subtitle: Automate routine work · investigate with evidence · verify outcomes
en.speech: The goal is practical: less repetitive work, clearer investigations and traceable operational workflows for VMware teams. Start with one read-only task, validate the result, and add automation where it helps. VMware Skills is a community project, not an official VMware or Broadcom product. Feedback and contributions are welcome.

zh.title: VMware 自动化，AI 辅助运维。
zh.subtitle: 面向运维团队 · 提升效率 · 操作可追溯
zh.speech: VMware 运维团队每天都要查询清单、调查故障和处理重复变更。VMware Skills 把 AI 辅助与专业自动化工具带到这些工作中，目的是减少重复收集信息，让判断有证据，让操作可追溯。原有权限和审计仍在流程中，建议先从只读 Monitor 开始。

zh.title: 一个家族，明确分工。
zh.subtitle: 15 个 skill · 14 个 MCP server · 共享 Policy 库
zh.speech: 整个家族覆盖计算、网络、存储和可观测性。Pilot 编排工作流，领域服务连接各自的管理系统，Policy 提供共享策略检查、文本清洗和审计。建议从只读 Monitor 开始。

zh.title: 中文提问，中文清单。
zh.subtitle: 中文历史截图 · 原图与大字转录
zh.speech: 这里展示中文历史会话截图。清单列出十三台虚拟机，其中六台运行中，七台已关机。画面保留中文原图，并用大字转录突出关键数值。主机地址和虚拟机名称已省略。

zh.title: 看健康，也核对当前状态。
zh.subtitle: 中文历史报告 · 保留原始数值
zh.speech: 中文健康报告记录两台已连接主机和两条严重告警。这里展示的是当时的观测，不能据此判断当前故障。处理前，应重新核对告警时间和当前状态。

zh.title: 需要变更时，先明确边界。
zh.subtitle: 评估 → 复核 → 执行 → 验证
zh.speech: 需要变更时，再选择对应领域技能和经过复核的工作流。VMware 原有权限与本地策略继续生效。破坏性工具有预览和确认门，但确认参数并不等于独立人工审批，回滚也只能尽力执行。

zh.title: 另有辅助能力：模型适配自测。
zh.subtitle: 用合成任务辅助选型，不执行真实操作
zh.speech: 还提供一项辅助能力：模型适配自测。团队可以用相同的合成任务，结合自动检查和人工复核，判断模型是否适合自己的工作。自测不执行 VMware 变更，也不代表生产可靠性保证。

zh.title: 最后，用中文审计记录追溯调用。
zh.subtitle: 三屏日志节选 · 已省略目标标识
zh.speech: 最后看中文审计记录。截图中的助手汇总标注，这批调用全部经由 CLI。演示选取十五条记录，按三屏展示审计编号、时间、技能、工具和状态。目标列已经省略，下方大字逐条转录。完整性仍需核对原始记录。

zh.title: 让 VMware 团队，工作更高效。
zh.subtitle: 减少重复工作 · 依证据调查 · 验证结果
zh.speech: 目标很实际：减少重复工作，让故障调查更清晰，让自动化流程可追溯。先验证一个只读任务，再按需要加入自动化。VMware Skills 是社区项目，并非 VMware 或 Broadcom 官方产品。欢迎运维团队试用，反馈经验，一起改进。
